dedupe_keys.name: united states northeast cleaned distribution network metrics

description: The US Northeast electric-network team publishes a cleaned set of medium-voltage distribution segments. The Harvard Dataverse description reports 3,978,273 line records and fields for hosting capacity, voltage, circuit rating, phases, utility, state, substation and census-tract GEOID. Coverage reaches part of seven northeastern states, not every local secondary connection. The public cleaned ZIP is available from Harvard Dataverse for download and is free under CC BY 4.0. Its geometry and ratings can prepare feeder-topology and distributed-generation capacity inputs for simulations; model-pypsa is a related but higher-level network model. A caveat is that hosting capacity is a utility estimate under specific conditions, not guaranteed connection permission. The provider reports partial population and land-area coverage, so absence of a line does not prove absence of service. The own metadata and file listing were inspected without downloading geometries or testing network connectivity.
